query:
SELECT r.id AS "id: AttemptId", r.name, r.uid AS "uid!"
            FROM docker_sandbox_tokens t
            JOIN agent_resources r ON r.id = t.attempt_id
            WHERE t.token_hash = $1
              AND r.kind = 'pod'
              AND r.namespace = 'docker'
              AND r.phase = 'bound'
              AND r.kubernetes_phase = 'Running'
